title: Lead Data Analyst, Growth & Experimentation
skills: The CEO personally engages with test design here: real organizational weight, no fight for buy-in
You partner directly with the Director of CRO, performance marketing, and Growth PMs, who come to you when a test needs a call

Experimentation rigor: test design, power and sample-size calls, significance and readout standards. Core of the role: you catch underpowered tests and false positives before they become bad decisions, and you get Growth's tests onto the anytime-valid monitoring the program already runs, so early calls come from a crossed boundary instead of a hopeful trend read

description:
About LawnStarter

LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $150M in annual bookings. We're expanding beyond lawn care into the one-stop shop for all home services. Getting there depends on how fast we can test, learn, and scale what works.

About The Data Team

We're a high-leverage team of Product Data Analysts embedded across the business, owning the semantic layer and the metrics everyone trusts. The experimentation program runs on real rigor, not vibes: pre-registered analysis plans gate every test launch, anytime-valid statistics keep mid-run dashboards honest under continuous viewing, automated daily SRM and attribution health sweeps catch broken tests early, and seasonal power forecasting accounts for a business that swings hard by time of year. The test lifecycle, design through readout, is already AI-driven. Our analysts are stretched across product, so Growth support has stayed part-time and reactive, until now.

The Role

You're the first data analyst dedicated entirely to Growth and Experimentation. Your primary charter is the experimentation program: test design, statistical rigor, and readouts across web funnels, SMS/drip, sales-driven tests, and SEO tests built on our own page-clustering tooling. It's a wider surface than most companies run. You also own the acquisition-to-conversion funnel those tests move, across paid, organic, and partner channels. What to test and which direction to bet on is the CRO's and Growth PMs' call; you shape it, they decide it.

You're not starting from scratch. Dashboards, tooling, and rigor scaffolding are already shipped and running. Expect the early months to be hands-on and manual: scoping tests, crunching readouts, while you build toward a self-serve layer. If a test readout and a funnel refresh ever compete for your week, the test wins.

What Makes This Role Different


The CEO personally engages with test design here: real organizational weight, no fight for buy-in
You partner directly with the Director of CRO, performance marketing, and Growth PMs, who come to you when a test needs a call


Requirements

What You'll Own


Experimentation rigor: test design, power and sample-size calls, significance and readout standards. Core of the role: you catch underpowered tests and false positives before they become bad decisions, and you get Growth's tests onto the anytime-valid monitoring the program already runs, so early calls come from a crossed boundary instead of a hopeful trend read
The self-serve experimentation layer: automated Growth metrics in Lightdash, Python-backed stat-sig tooling, and the AI skills (Claude routines) already handling pre-test power calcs and live-test health checks. You extend these and keep the layer correct as product and tracking evolve
The Growth funnel model: a trusted, instrumented view of visitor → lead → customer across every brand and channel, with the CAC, LTV, and conversion-rate cuts Growth needs to prioritize investment
The Growth analytics function model: by end of Year 1, the standards and playbook that scale this function beyond one person, plus a buy-vs-build recommendation for the experimentation stack (an off-the-shelf stats engine, or extending our own skills and Python). You bring the recommendation; the final call isn't yours alone


Problems to Solve

Tests that can't answer the question they were run for Growth wants more experiments, but volume without rigor produces confident, wrong conclusions. Raising the bar without becoming the bottleneck is the job.

Getting off the manual treadmill Real tooling already exists: test-design helpers, dashboards, AI skills. Most tests are still hands-on and bespoke. How do you extend that automation so routine cases genuinely self-serve?

Making the funnel decision-grade The semantic layer defines the funnel, but instrumentation is uneven across brands and channels, and no one owns the single trusted view. You build it, and you keep it trusted.

Turning analysis into decisions The hard part isn't the SQL. It's getting a PM or marketer to change course. Can you deliver insight sharp enough that the room acts, and push back when the data favors the popular but wrong idea?

What Success Looks Like (Year 1)


Rigor is the default. Power calculations are standard practice, early stops on Growth tests come from the anytime-valid boundary rather than a trend read, and the re-run rate (redone for tracking or attribution problems) is down
Routine tests self-serve. Metrics and stat-sig are automated in Lightdash, so the team reads standard results without filing a ticket, and your time goes to the tests that need an analyst
A funnel Growth trusts. The acquisition→conversion funnel is instrumented across every brand and channel; Growth prioritizes off your model, not side spreadsheets
Measurable conversion wins. Your analysis directly drove specific, quantified lifts in the funnel, and you can name them


Who You Are

AI-native. You use AI daily for SQL, dbt, and pressure-testing your analysis, extending the skills already running our experimentation process rather than merely using them. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you're skeptical of AI or treat your workflow as fixed.

A partner, not a report-writer. You don't wait for a ticket. You sit close to Growth and bring the question before anyone asks it. Skip this one if you want a clear queue with no expectation to push back.

Statistically sharp. Wrong fit if "we hit significance" ends your analysis instead of starting it. Right fit if you have a point of view on test design (power, significance, novelty and interaction effects, when not to test) and can explain a broken experiment in plain terms.

Fluent in experiment instrumentation. You know how Segment events and Flagsmith randomization interact, and catch a tracking problem before a test ships, keeping our re-run rate down. This isn't for you if instrumentation is someone else's job.

Fluent in the funnel. You think in CAC, LTV, and channel economics, and know acquisition data's quirks: attribution messiness, seasonality, channel mix. Skip this one if your background is pure product-feature analytics.

Technically self-sufficient. Wrong fit if you need clean data handed to you. Expert SQL, enough Python to automate the stat-sig math, and comfort in dbt and Lightdash, building your own models without waiting on data engineering.

Influences without authority. PMs and marketers act on what you find because your insight is clear and honest about uncertainty. This isn't for you if you consider the job done once the analysis ships, regardless of outcome.

This Role Is NOT

The person who decides what to test. You shape that call and own its rigor, but the roadmap and final direction belong to the CRO and Growth PMs

PROPÓSITO DEL PUESTO

Responsable de administrar programas comerciales, promociones, marketing local, proveedores y proyectos de desarrollo del canal, aplicando creatividad práctica para transformar oportunidades en soluciones, promociones y experiencias diferenciadas. Apoya la toma de decisiones mediante análisis de negocio, casos de inversión y recomendaciones basadas en datos.


 RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPALES
 Crecimiento y desarrollo del canal D2C


Desarrollar y ejecutar iniciativas que incrementen el tráfico, las ventas y la rentabilidad de Centros de Servicio y Servicio a Domicilio. Identificar oportunidades, alianzas, convenios y mejores prácticas, y proponer soluciones creativas y viables que fortalezcan el desempeño, la diferenciación y la madurez del punto de venta.


 Promociones y activación de demanda


Administrar y ejecutar promociones, campañas estacionales y programas comerciales. Diseñar mecánicas y activaciones creativas, prácticas y ejecutables que generen demanda y valor para el cliente. Evaluar resultados y recomendar mejoras para maximizar el impacto y el retorno de inversión.


 Capacidades D2C y excelencia operativa


Desarrollar, documentar y desplegar procesos, playbooks, herramientas y mejores prácticas que mejoren la consistencia de ejecución y permitan escalar el modelo D2C a través de la red.


 Marketing local y generación de tráfico


Administrar la estrategia de Google Business Profile y las iniciativas digitales orientadas a incrementar visibilidad y visitas a los Centros de Servicio. Medir el desempeño por ubicación y proponer acciones de optimización.


 Análisis de negocio y gestión del desempeño


Analizar ventas, mezcla, rentabilidad, promociones y KPIs del canal. Desarrollar casos de negocio y recomendaciones que apoyen la planeación, la toma de decisiones y la mejora continua.


 Gestión de presupuesto, agencias y proveedores


Administrar las iniciativas asignadas dentro del presupuesto D2C y coordinar agencias, proveedores, órdenes de compra y entregables. Negociar condiciones, asegurar calidad, controlar costes y reportar avances al Gerente de Mercadotecnia D2C.


 Colaboración transversal y propuesta de valor


Coordinar la implementación con las áreas internas y distribuidores. Participar en la evolución de la propuesta de valor aportando la perspectiva de marketing D2C y propuestas creativas de experiencia y diferenciación, y coordinando las acciones aprobadas, sin ser responsable de la estrategia de marca, el diseño arquitectónico o nuevos modelos de negocio.

Licenciatura en Mercadotecnia, Administración, Negocios, Ingeniería Comercial, Ingeniería Industrial o carrera afín. Especialización en Marketing Digital, Analítica o Desarrollo Comercial es deseable.

Experiencia

5 años o más en Marketing, Trade Marketing, Retail Marketing, Desarrollo Comercial, canales de distribución o negocios D2C. Experiencia en gestión de proyectos, agencias, proveedores y análisis comercial.

Habilidades técnicas

Marketing D2C, marketing digital, Google Business Profile, performance marketing, análisis financiero básico, gestión de proyectos, Excel avanzado, Power BI deseable y desarrollo de casos de negocio.

Habilidades conductuales

Orientación a resultados, pensamiento analítico y estratégico, organización, autonomía, negociación, colaboración, influencia sin autoridad formal y enfoque al cliente. Creatividad práctica para proponer soluciones, promociones y experiencias que generen demanda, diferenciación y valor para el cliente.

Crecimiento de ventas y tráfico en Centros de Servicio y Servicio a Domicilio.

ROI y efectividad de campañas y promociones.

Adopción y efectividad de programas, playbooks y procesos D2C. 
Cumplimiento presupuestal y desempeño de agencias y proveedores. 


About Clarios

Clarios is the global leader in advanced, low-voltage battery technologies for mobility. Our batteries and smart solutions power nearly every type of vehicle and are found in 1 of 3 cars on the road today. WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. Skills And Experience


2+ years' experience in Ad Operations, Digital Activation, Campaign Management or DCO platforms such as: Flashtalking/Innovid, Smartly, Celtra, etc. 
Advanced level of English (this will be assessed during the interview process) 
Bachelor’s degree 
Proven understanding of digital media channels and campaign delivery fundamentals, with hands-on experience using ad-serving and trafficking platforms.

Highly organized with sharp attention to detail, strong process management skills, and clear verbal and written communication.

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

Only Mexican nationals residing in the country or foreign nationals with a valid work permit may apply. Remote work from abroad is not permitted under any circumstances.

While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

description:
About LawnStarter

LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $150M in annual bookings. We're expanding beyond lawn care into the one-stop shop for all home services. Getting there depends on how fast we can test, learn, and scale what works.

About The Data Team

We're a high-leverage team of Product Data Analysts embedded across the business, owning the semantic layer and the metrics everyone trusts. The experimentation program runs on real rigor, not vibes: pre-registered analysis plans gate every test launch, anytime-valid statistics keep mid-run dashboards honest under continuous viewing, automated daily SRM and attribution health sweeps catch broken tests early, and seasonal power forecasting accounts for a business that swings hard by time of year. The test lifecycle, design through readout, is already AI-driven. Our analysts are stretched across product, so Growth support has stayed part-time and reactive, until now.

The Role

You're the first data analyst dedicated entirely to Growth and Experimentation. Your primary charter is the experimentation program: test design, statistical rigor, and readouts across web funnels, SMS/drip, sales-driven tests, and SEO tests built on our own page-clustering tooling. It's a wider surface than most companies run. You also own the acquisition-to-conversion funnel those tests move, across paid, organic, and partner channels. What to test and which direction to bet on is the CRO's and Growth PMs' call; you shape it, they decide it.

You're not starting from scratch. Dashboards, tooling, and rigor scaffolding are already shipped and running. Expect the early months to be hands-on and manual: scoping tests, crunching readouts, while you build toward a self-serve layer. If a test readout and a funnel refresh ever compete for your week, the test wins.

What Makes This Role Different


The CEO personally engages with test design here: real organizational weight, no fight for buy-in
You partner directly with the Director of CRO, performance marketing, and Growth PMs, who come to you when a test needs a call


Requirements

What You'll Own


Experimentation rigor: test design, power and sample-size calls, significance and readout standards. Core of the role: you catch underpowered tests and false positives before they become bad decisions, and you get Growth's tests onto the anytime-valid monitoring the program already runs, so early calls come from a crossed boundary instead of a hopeful trend read
The self-serve experimentation layer: automated Growth metrics in Lightdash, Python-backed stat-sig tooling, and the AI skills (Claude routines) already handling pre-test power calcs and live-test health checks. You extend these and keep the layer correct as product and tracking evolve
The Growth funnel model: a trusted, instrumented view of visitor → lead → customer across every brand and channel, with the CAC, LTV, and conversion-rate cuts Growth needs to prioritize investment
The Growth analytics function model: by end of Year 1, the standards and playbook that scale this function beyond one person, plus a buy-vs-build recommendation for the experimentation stack (an off-the-shelf stats engine, or extending our own skills and Python). You bring the recommendation; the final call isn't yours alone


Problems to Solve

Tests that can't answer the question they were run for Growth wants more experiments, but volume without rigor produces confident, wrong conclusions. Raising the bar without becoming the bottleneck is the job.

Getting off the manual treadmill Real tooling already exists: test-design helpers, dashboards, AI skills. Most tests are still hands-on and bespoke. How do you extend that automation so routine cases genuinely self-serve?

Making the funnel decision-grade The semantic layer defines the funnel, but instrumentation is uneven across brands and channels, and no one owns the single trusted view. You build it, and you keep it trusted.

Turning analysis into decisions The hard part isn't the SQL. It's getting a PM or marketer to change course. Can you deliver insight sharp enough that the room acts, and push back when the data favors the popular but wrong idea?

What Success Looks Like (Year 1)


Rigor is the default. Power calculations are standard practice, early stops on Growth tests come from the anytime-valid boundary rather than a trend read, and the re-run rate (redone for tracking or attribution problems) is down
Routine tests self-serve. Metrics and stat-sig are automated in Lightdash, so the team reads standard results without filing a ticket, and your time goes to the tests that need an analyst
A funnel Growth trusts. The acquisition→conversion funnel is instrumented across every brand and channel; Growth prioritizes off your model, not side spreadsheets
Measurable conversion wins. Your analysis directly drove specific, quantified lifts in the funnel, and you can name them


Who You Are

AI-native. You use AI daily for SQL, dbt, and pressure-testing your analysis, extending the skills already running our experimentation process rather than merely using them. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you're skeptical of AI or treat your workflow as fixed.

A partner, not a report-writer. You don't wait for a ticket. You sit close to Growth and bring the question before anyone asks it. Skip this one if you want a clear queue with no expectation to push back.

Statistically sharp. Wrong fit if "we hit significance" ends your analysis instead of starting it. Right fit if you have a point of view on test design (power, significance, novelty and interaction effects, when not to test) and can explain a broken experiment in plain terms.

Fluent in experiment instrumentation. You know how Segment events and Flagsmith randomization interact, and catch a tracking problem before a test ships, keeping our re-run rate down. This isn't for you if instrumentation is someone else's job.

Fluent in the funnel. You think in CAC, LTV, and channel economics, and know acquisition data's quirks: attribution messiness, seasonality, channel mix. Skip this one if your background is pure product-feature analytics.

Technically self-sufficient. Wrong fit if you need clean data handed to you. Expert SQL, enough Python to automate the stat-sig math, and comfort in dbt and Lightdash, building your own models without waiting on data engineering.

Influences without authority. PMs and marketers act on what you find because your insight is clear and honest about uncertainty. This isn't for you if you consider the job done once the analysis ships, regardless of outcome.

This Role Is NOT


A ticket queue. Not the role if you want well-defined asks: no one hands you a backlog of number-pulls, you decide what's worth measuring
The person who decides what to test. You shape that call and own its rigor, but the roadmap and final direction belong to the CRO and Growth PMs
A product-feature analyst seat. Existing analysts already own product, pricing, and service delivery; this one lives in Growth: acquisition, conversion, experimentation
A pure platform or dashboard-builder. You'll automate metrics, stat-sig, and AI skills into a self-serve layer, but that's the means. The job is designing experiments and keeping that automation correct as product and tracking evolve
A people-management role. This is an individual-contributor seat


Benefits


Base salary: $75,000-$100,000 USD annually
The scope is the draw: First analyst dedicated entirely to Growth and Experimentation, with your fingerprints on how this company decides what works
AI tooling provided: The Claude routines already running pieces of our experimentation process are yours to extend, not a side project you have to justify
Fully remote: This is deep-focus analytical work with US-facing partners. We hire the best analyst regardless of city and trust you to manage your environment and overlap hours
Flexible PTO: Measured on outcomes, not hours logged

 Full time

title: Senior Brand Partnerships Manager, Financial Services - Mexico - GBS
description:
Responsibilities
TikTok's Global Business Solutions (GBS) regional sales and advertising teams drive revenue growth by promoting our advertising solutions, onboarding clients, and running campaigns that deliver measurable results.

Client needs, market trends, and performance expectations shift constantly, and differently in every market. We build strategy accordingly, turning those moving pieces into advertising solutions that work and client partnerships that last.

You will help businesses grow on a global platform, working on the campaigns and relationships that turn advertisers into long-term partners.

We are looking for a Senior Brand Partnerships Manager, Financial Services to lead growth with strategic FinServ advertisers across Mexico. This person will own senior client relationships, build full-funnel growth plans, and turn platform capabilities into measurable business outcomes for banks, fintechs, payments companies, lending players, wallets, investment platforms, and insurance advertisers.

The right candidate combines strong commercial judgment with hands-on performance-marketing fluency. They can discuss CAC, ROAS, funnel leakage, app acquisition, web conversion, lead quality, creative testing, incrementality, measurement, and media mix with a performance team, then translate those topics into a board-level growth narrative with client leadership. They also understand digital media partnerships: how platforms, networks, creators, placements, ad products, measurement solutions, incentives, and joint business plans come together to create durable client growth.

This is a senior IC role for someone who wants to learn aggressively while also developing the business, the client portfolio, and the team’s market perspective. The role requires someone who can think beyond a single account and help define how the broader LATAM FinServ industry should grow with TikTok and partner media solutions.

Core Responsibilities:
Market and Account Growth
- Own and grow a portfolio of strategic LATAM FinServ advertisers, with a focus on revenue expansion, forecast accuracy, and senior client influence.
- Build account plans that connect client business priorities to measurable media outcomes, including user acquisition, funded accounts, loan applications, card acquisition, deposits, app activation, qualified leads, and brand consideration.
- Identify share-of-wallet opportunities in mature accounts and build entry strategies for accounts where platform adoption is still early.
- Convert quarterly forecast gaps into account-level action plans, including upsell opportunities, incentive plans, creative actions, measurement fixes, and partner-product adoption.

Performance Marketing Excellence
- Act as a credible thought partner for client performance teams, growth leads, media agencies, and internal performance specialists.
- Diagnose campaign performance across funnel stage, objective, optimization event, audience setup, creative volume, bidding, budget allocation, landing-page or app flow, and measurement setup.
- Build scalable performance playbooks for FinServ use cases, including app acquisition, web conversion, lead generation, retargeting, creator-led performance, and branding-to-performance handoffs.
- Push clients from tactical media buying toward structured test-and-learn programs with clear hypotheses, clean measurement, and repeatable decision rules.
- Translate technical or operational blockers into commercial actions, so issues like campaign pauses, event setup, creative shortages, tracking gaps, or product readiness do not sit outside the revenue plan.

Digital Media Partnerships
- Develop partnership motions that connect TikTok, Pangle, partner inventory, measurement, creative, incentives, and product adoption into one client growth story.
- Build joint business plans with strategic FinServ clients, including quarterly priorities, product adoption roadmap, investment commitments, operating cadence, and executive checkpoints.
- Work with internal partner teams to shape proposals that reflect how banks, fintechs, lenders, and payments companies actually make media decisions.
- Help clients understand when to use branding, performance, app, web, lead-generation, consideration, and partner-network solutions, and how those motions reinforce each other.
- Represent the FinServ vertical in cross-functional discussions where media partnerships, product roadmaps, measurement, and commercial incentives need a clear industry point of view.

Industry Ownership
- Build and maintain a sharp view of FinServ trends, including digital banking, credit, payments, wallets, super-apps, lending cycles, regulatory sensitivity, app adoption, and competitive media behavior.
- Turn market changes into practical client strategies, for example competitive-response playbooks, app-growth recovery plans, or wallet-share expansion frameworks.
- Develop repeatable vertical narratives that help the team explain why TikTok and partner media solutions matter for the next phase of FinServ growth.
- Coach internal stakeholders on FinServ business models, client decision cycles, risk constraints, and the difference between brand, acquisition, and monetization objectives.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualification(s):
- 7+ years in digital advertising, performance marketing, media partnerships, consulting, fintech growth, banking partnerships, or enterprise account leadership.
- Direct experience with financial-services advertisers, ideally across fintech, banking, credit, payments, wallets, investment, insurance, or lending.
- Experience owning large strategic accounts, joint business plans, quarterly business reviews, annual planning, and executive stakeholder management.
- Strong understanding of app marketing and web/lead-generation funnels, including event strategy, conversion quality, measurement limitations, and creative-performance dynamics.
- Experience working with media platforms, ad networks, agencies, measurement partners, or partner-inventory solutions.
- Ability to operate in ambiguity, especially when coverage, forecast, product readiness, or client information is incomplete.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​


TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request​

description:
This is where your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

Tu rol en Baxter

Serás responsable de apoyar el desarrollo e implementación de estrategias de marketing orientadas al crecimiento, utilizando análisis de mercado, conocimiento del cliente e inteligencia competitiva para identificar oportunidades y generar recomendaciones accionables.

El éxito en esta posición se medirá a través de la calidad de la ejecución de los planes de marketing, el impacto de las iniciativas implementadas, la generación de insights de negocio y la colaboración efectiva con los diferentes stakeholders de la organización.

Tu equipo

Formarás parte de un equipo dinámico y altamente colaborativo que trabaja en estrecha coordinación con las áreas de Ventas, Medical Affairs, Finanzas, Regulatory y Compliance. Tendrás la oportunidad de interactuar con profesionales de distintas funciones, contribuir a proyectos estratégicos y desarrollar una visión integral del negocio.

Role Title: Research Marketing Lead (Remote)
Role Type: Full-time

The Role

We’re looking for a Research Marketing Lead to own how our research, benchmarks, and technical work are positioned, launched, and adopted across the AI ecosystem.




You’ll work closely with our research team to turn technical work into high-impact launches that earn attention, adoption, and citations. You’ll develop a deep understanding of our research and methodology, shape positioning and narratives, establish a high quality bar for publication, and build go-to-market strategies that put our work in front of the right researchers, developers, AI labs, and technical audiences.




What You'll Do

1. Own research GTM end-to-end, developing launch and distribution strategies for research, benchmarks, evaluations, and other technical work.

2. Establish the publication-readiness bar for research and benchmarks, partnering with researchers to ensure methodology, claims, results, and supporting materials are rigorous, clear, and defensible before launch.

3. Develop positioning and narratives that translate complex technical findings into clear, differentiated stories without sacrificing technical accuracy or depth.

4. Identify high-impact research opportunities by understanding emerging AI trends, open questions, competitive research, and what matters to researchers and practitioners.

5. Shape research packaging and distribution, including research pages, benchmark releases, technical content, launch materials, and other assets that drive discovery and usage.

6. Build relationships across the AI research ecosystem, including researchers, AI labs, developers, technical communities, and influential practitioners.

7. Drive adoption of our research and benchmarks, identifying the audiences, communities, and channels most likely to use, reference, and build on our work.

8. Measure research impact, tracking adoption, citations, engagement, usage, and qualitative feedback to understand what resonates and where our work is creating value.

9. Create feedback loops between the market and research, bringing ecosystem insights back to the research team to inform future benchmarks, evaluations, and research priorities.




What We're Looking For

1. Experience marketing, launching, or driving adoption of technical research, AI/ML products, developer products, benchmarks, evaluations, or similarly complex technical work.

2. Strong track record developing and executing go-to-market strategies for technical audiences.

3. Ability to deeply understand technical work and translate it into clear, credible, differentiated positioning and narratives.

4. Strong understanding of the AI/ML research ecosystem, including major labs, research trends, benchmarks, evaluations, and technical communities.

5. Exceptional written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both highly technical and broader audiences.

6. Strong analytical judgment and the ability to evaluate whether technical claims, supporting evidence, and research materials are ready for external publication.

7. Experience building relationships with researchers, technical leaders, developers, or AI communities.

8. High ownership and the ability to take ambiguous initiatives from strategy through execution.

9. Strong cross-functional skills and the ability to work closely with researchers while maintaining a high bar for technical accuracy and quality.




Preferred

1. Background in AI, machine learning, computer science, or another technical field.

2. Experience at an AI lab, AI-native company, research organization, developer-focused company, or highly technical startup.

3. Experience working directly with research teams and technical leadership.

5. Experience launching technical content or research that achieved meaningful adoption, citations, community engagement, or industry impact.

Copywriting

Qualifications

- Expert-level Meta ads experience with proven, measurable results

- Hands-on experience running paid campaigns on Google, YouTube and TikTok

- Strong experience in creative strategy, media buying, funnel strategy and copywriting

- A strong ownership mindset and the ability to work independently from day one

This role is not for you if you:

Work Arrangement

- Fully remote

description:
Overview

About the Role & Team

IDC is seeking a Customer Success Manager to join our team. In this role, you will own a portfolio of

IDC’s strategic, high-value customer accounts and serve as the primary post-sale relationship owner,

leading executive engagement, success planning, and renewal strategy in close partnership with

Sales Account Directors. This is not a support role. It is a commercially minded, outcome-driven

position where you are directly accountable for retention, expansion influence, and measurable

customer outcomes.

A defining part of this role is leading customer engagement with Quanta, IDC’s AI offering. You will

get customer users to adopt Quanta in their daily work, build usage habits across their teams, and

connect that usage to the business outcomes they care about.

You will manage up to 30 strategic accounts. Your customers are senior technology executives at the

world’s leading IT vendors and buyers who rely on IDC’s data, insights, and advisory to make

high-stakes decisions. You will also serve as the bridge between the client and IDC’s internal teams,

feeding critical insights back to Sales, Analysts, and Product to deepen engagement and identify

opportunities for growth and expansion.

What You’ll Do

Driving Account Value Realization: Manage customer relationships to maximize customer

satisfaction and ensure continued engagement with IDC’s products. Understand customers’ strategic

goals, challenges, and how IDC’s solutions can address their needs.


 Leading Quanta Engagement and AI Adoption: Onboard customer users to Quanta and keep


adoption going well past the onboarding session. Coach users on applying Quanta to their priorities,

build usage habits across the customer’s team, and use usage signals to spot under-adopting

accounts early.


 Developing Account Strategy and Expansion: Build strategic account success plans around


customer-owned goals to deepen relationships with client stakeholders, positioning IDC as the

preferred market intelligence and tech insights partner. Engage senior customer executives to

understand their vision, align on mutual goals, and map future-state roadmaps that illustrate how

IDC supports their success.


 Ensuring Customer Enablement & Adoption: Manage onboarding and solution adoption across IDC’s


research, advisory, and Quanta, ensuring clients see value from IDC’s offerings. Drive regular

executive reviews and deliver customer success milestones, collaborating with internal teams to

resolve customer issues and refine product alignment.


 Customer Relationship Development: Navigate customer organizations to strengthen relationships,


find influence, and understand business needs.


 Performance and Business Reviews: Conduct regular business reviews that tie engagement and


Quanta usage to measurable customer value, reinforce ROI, and identify innovative solutions.


 Owning the Renewal Outcome: Track and score renewal risk, lead mitigation plans, and partner


with Sales so value is visible well ahead of the renewal conversation.

What You Bring


 Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in customer success, account management, or a related field,


preferably in the IT industry


 Bachelor’s Degree is preferred or equivalent experience
 Demonstrated success managing a portfolio of strategic, high-value accounts with complex


stakeholder environments


 Track record of meeting or exceeding retention (GRR) and net revenue retention (NRR) targets
 Experience driving adoption of AI, analytics, or other data-driven platforms with enterprise users,


including getting non-technical executives and teams to build lasting usage habits


 Comfort coaching users on prompting and AI-assisted research, and the credibility to teach and


enable peers


 Ability to turn product usage data into a customer value story tied to customer-owned goals
 Hands-on curiosity about AI tools and the willingness to keep learning as they evolve
 Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to


identifying and addressing client needs


 Knowledge of Salesforce and Microsoft 365
 Knowledge of tools like Gainsight or ChurnZero is preferred
 Must be able to travel within region to visit key customers (10% travel)


Why This Role Stands Out

At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions.

Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long-term career development with a globally respected brand.

Equal Opportunity Employer

IDC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons. Employment eligibility verification required. We participate in E-Verify.

If this role relocates to a different country, the salary range will be updated to reflect that country's range, rather than a currency conversion of the original range.

There is never a day you don’t learn something new at CaptiveAire. I am able to learn something new due to the freedom to take on new tasks independently and problem solve.

I love the mindset of continuous learning and pushing the bounds of your capabilities and knowledge. I love the people I work with and the in-office work environment. I love how Captiveaire is all about connections, with customers, coworkers, end users, and everyone in between.

One of the things I appreciate most about CaptiveAire is how strongly it embodies the entrepreneurial spirit. I’m empowered with the autonomy to manage my work independently, while also benefiting from the robust support and resources of a large, well-established company.

CaptiveAire is fast-moving and no-nonsense. We operate differently than any other company that I've worked for with our decentralized structure. Quick action is taken when a good idea is presented. We are focused on end users where the rest of the industry is very short-sighted. We are on the front lines, actively changing the landscape of the HVAC industry.

Learn more about CaptiveAire and our products here

A Day In The Life

A technical sales role encompasses a wide variety of tasks where one day does not look exactly like the next. The projects our team handles are high in volume and unique from one another, spanning throughout the whole course of design, procurement, coordination, and post-sale support.

Typical Tasks Include


Outside sales meetings and calls to build relationships with existing and new customers
Application engineering to apply our products using sound engineering principles 
Project management of installations in progress - Managing schedules/plans to guarantee we can get equipment on site when the site needs it, in turn creating satisfied and returning customers. 
Service and technical support of existing equipment 
Supporting end users to maintain high levels of customer service, from assisting contractors with wiring on site to remote troubleshooting for staff in the kitchen. 


Two to three full days per week in the office working on bids, one to two days on job sites, and dedicate another day to developing the territory. Territory development may include giving presentations to the engineering community, visiting new customers, or expanding contacts with an existing account.

Comments From Some Of Our Sales Engineers

Every day I get to help someone. Whether it's an engineer with a design, a contractor with a troubleshooting issue, or an end user looking for help to obtain better indoor air quality. I get to use my engineering skills, people skills and business skills every day.

Our main "role" is not to sell products but to provide solutions - kitchen ventilation solutions, commercial ventilation solutions, heating/air conditioning solutions. I enjoy getting to work directly with end users and helping them complete their business goals. Attending a soft opening after completing a full design-build project with an owner is rewarding.

I love the balance between working on designs in the office and also having that face to face interaction with our customers. It's awesome to handle the design phase of a project, then also take charge of the procurement process with the end user/customer and lastly watch our equipment perform as designed once installed and the project is complete. I also love the growth aspect of my role, I enjoy molding and shaping our business in order to set it up for success and then see the value we are adding to the market.

Primary Job Responsibilities


Provide integrated application engineering and design support for a wide range of ventilation applications with the goal of providing sustainable products and the latest technologies best designed to meet the customers’ needs. 
Work directly with Engineers, Contractors, End Users, and Food Service Dealers. 
Daily tasks include inside sales support, application engineering and outside sales. 
Responsibilities will vary and may include presentations, quotes, submittals, technical product support, job site visits and hands on troubleshooting as needed. 
Educate and promote CaptiveAire products to users in your market.  This includes conference calls, meetings, organizing presentations, and product demos. 
Research and develop new business opportunities with new and existing users. 
Top notch customer service and willingness to go above and beyond to serve the customer. 
Quick turnaround times a priority.  
Continuously evaluate and improve processes as well as the customer experience. 


Required Skills


2-5 years industry experience needed
4 year technical degree in a mechanical, electrical, construction or science-oriented curriculum preferred 
Must be bilingual in English and Spanish
Excellent computer, organizational and communication/presentation skills 
Problem solving with a passion for continuous learning 
Strong desire to interface with the customer 
Embrace new technologies and business savvy 
Passion for work with aggressive nature to succeed 
Willing to travel for various training opportunities 
If not already completed, expectation of FE Exam completion in area of study for engineering graduates within 6 months of employment with CaptiveAire

description:
OUR PURPOSE AND CULTURE

We are driven to create a future where people and place enrich one another. We are wholly committed to rooting ourselves more deeply in every place we are in while setting new benchmarks for positive impact.

As a pioneering collective with a common purpose, we curate extraordinary moments and honor the soul of every place along our journey. At Rosewood Hotel Group, we answer The Calling. Together, we Make the Place.

The Sales & Marketing team at Las Ventanas al Paraíso is dedicated to cultivating meaningful relationships with travel advisors, industry partners, guests, and communities around the world. Through personalized engagement, strategic partnerships, and exceptional service, the team drives revenue while building long-term loyalty and advocacy for the Rosewood brand.

Reporting to the Director of Leisure Sales and the Director of Sales & Marketing, the Elite Sales Coordinator works closely with Sales, Reservations, Front Office, Concierge, Conference Services, Guest Experience, Romance, Catering, and Accounting teams to ensure seamless communication and exceptional support for our most valued partners and guests.

YOUR ROLE

As Elite Sales Coordinator, you will serve as an extension of the Sales team, supporting key travel advisor relationships, luxury consortia partners, and Rosewood Elite advisors. Acting as an important liaison between clients and the resort, you will help ensure timely communication, personalized guest experiences, and smooth coordination between commercial and operational teams.

This role contributes directly to the property's sales success by strengthening partner engagement, supporting revenue-generating initiatives, enhancing the guest journey before arrival, and ensuring the highest standard of service for luxury travel professionals and their clients.

HOW YOU’LL MAKE THE PLACE
Support Rosewood Elite advisors, luxury travel partners, and their clients by providing prompt and personalized communication throughout the pre-arrival journey.
Assist in maintaining travel advisor and agency profiles, tracking account activity, and supporting follow-up on sales opportunities.
Coordinate site inspections, familiarization trips, and hosted experiences to showcase the resort and strengthen industry partnerships.
Collaborate with Reservations, Concierge, Front Office, Guest Experience, and other departments to ensure seamless communication and personalized guest experiences.
Conduct market research, account tracking, and competitive analysis to support sales strategies and business development initiatives.
Prepare and submit sales reports, payroll summaries, production analysis, and other administrative documentation in a timely manner.
Support recognition programs and stay enhancements for Elite, Consortia, and repeat guests by communicating guest preferences and special requests.
Assist with departmental projects, purchase order processing, and operational coordination to support overall Sales & Marketing objectives.
COULD THIS BE YOU?
You are an excellent communicator who can confidently build relationships with luxury travel advisors, guests, and internal stakeholders in both English and Spanish.
You thrive in a fast-paced environment and can manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and exceptional attention to detail.
You have experience supporting hotel sales operations, preferably within a luxury hospitality environment.
You are comfortable using systems such as Microsoft Office, Opera, Delphi, and other hospitality technology platforms.
You can analyze information, prepare reports, and support business decisions through strong organizational and administrative skills.
You understand the expectations of luxury travelers and are passionate about delivering highly personalized service experiences.
You are a collaborative team player who builds positive working relationships across departments and levels of the organization.
You handle confidential guest and business information with professionalism, discretion, and integrity.

description:
Responsibilities
The Mexico Marketing Team is a strategic marketing function within Global Business Marketing (GBM) responsible for accelerating TikTok’s growth through its B2B event strategy and execution in Mexico.

We work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product Marketing, Partnerships, and regional teams to translate business priorities into event experiences that inform, inspire, and engage.

As the Event Specialist, you will support the planning, coordination, production, and execution of TikTok Mexico’s B2B events, taking ownership of specific operational workstreams and ensuring organized and timely follow-up throughout each project, under the direction of the Event Manager.

You will work closely with the Event Manager throughout the entire event lifecycle, actively contributing to efficient, high-quality execution. This includes supporting event planning and logistics, coordinating agencies and vendors, managing operational workstreams, and participating in on-site execution to ensure a smooth experience for attendees and stakeholders.

Responsibilities
- Support the planning and production of B2B events across different formats and scales in Mexico, working closely with the Event Manager and production team.
- Coordinate assigned operational workstreams throughout the event lifecycle, ensuring clear ownership, organized execution, and alignment with project requirements.
- Track project timelines, checklists, action items, deliverables, dependencies, and risks, escalating delays or issues to the Event Manager as needed.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date project documentation, including trackers, calendars, timelines, Run of Show documents, meeting notes, and shared project files.
- Coordinate with internal teams, including Sales, Marketing, and other cross-functional partners, to follow up on action items, owners, deadlines, approvals, and dependencies.
- Coordinate defined logistics and deliverables with venues, agencies, vendors, and partners, including quotations, documentation, materials, shipments, access requirements, and production needs.
- Support vendor and administrative processes, including purchase orders, contracts, invoices, approvals, payments, and other required documentation in coordination with internal teams.
- Support event logistics for registration, accreditation, guest lists, speakers, clients, talent, transportation, schedules, and attendee needs, helping ensure a smooth and cohesive attendee experience.
- Participate actively in event setup, rehearsals, live execution, and breakdown, taking ownership of assigned operational areas and executing responsibilities according to the production plan and Run of Show.
- Coordinate on-site workstreams such as registration, backstage operations, room turns, materials, guest flows, and vendor requirements, ensuring alignment with the overall production plan.
- Monitor and resolve operational issues within the assigned scope, escalating higher-impact decisions or risks to the Event Manager when necessary.
- Support production and project follow-up meetings by documenting agreements, owners, deadlines, and next steps, and ensuring timely follow-through.
- Support event reconciliation and administrative closeout, including final documentation, cost tracking, vendor follow-up, and capture of key learnings.
- Contribute to a collaborative and solutions-oriented working environment, supporting internal stakeholders, vendors, agencies, and external teams throughout event delivery.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualification(s)
- Minimum 1+ years of experience in events, production, experiential marketing, hospitality, or related fields.
- Experience supporting or coordinating events, with strong organizational skills and attention to detail and the ability to manage timelines, multiple priorities, and workstreams simultaneously.
- Proactive, hands-on, and solution-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to adapt to changing needs in dynamic, fast-paced environments.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal teams, external partners, and vendors.
- Willingness and availability to work on-site and accommodate event-related schedules, including early mornings, evenings, and occasional weekends as required.

Preferred Qualification(s)
- Experience working on B2B or corporate events, particularly within media, technology, entertainment, or advertising industries.
- Experience coordinating vendors, agencies, and venues across multiple projects or events.
- Familiarity with event production processes, including Run of Show, technical rehearsals, and on-site operations.
- Experience working with project management or event management tools to track tasks, timelines, and documentation.
- Ability to troubleshoot operational issues in real time.
- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to anticipate operational needs or risks.
- Demonstrated ability to work effectively as part of a cross-functional team and build collaborative working relationships.

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. 1. Propósito del puesto.

Convertir el sell-out, el inventario en cliente y el sell-in en conclusiones y acciones concretas para sus tres socios de negocio: Comercial, Sales Finance & Commercial Planning y Marketing. Cada análisis responde: ¿crecemos?, ¿qué lo explica?, ¿dónde está el riesgo? y ¿qué hacemos?

No es un puesto de armar reportes: es de entender, concluir, recomendar y dar seguimiento hasta cerrar.

2. Responsabilidades Principales: 

• Análisis integral. Sell-out, inventario y sell-in en piezas y pesos vs. año anterior, por cliente, marca, licencia, categoría e ítem.

• Desplazamiento por marca para Marketing. Identifica qué marcas y licencias impulsar y cuáles corregir, y lo entrega a Marketing como insumo de los planes de marca y del AOP.

• Riesgo de inventario. Detecta marcas con caída y alto inventario en cliente, y alerta a Sales Finance & Commercial Planning sobre posibles notas de crédito.

• Calidad del dato. Valida con KAMs y Team Leaders, cuadra totales y documenta la fecha de corte.

• Presentación y seguimiento. Abre con hallazgos clave y cierra acuerdos con dueño y fecha con Comercial y Marketing. 3 

3. Competencias Técnicas:

• Sell-in, sell-out, inventario y cobertura; precio al público vs. sell-in y descuentos.

• Explicar si la venta cambió por piezas, precio o mezcla, por cliente y por marca.

• Saber que el bajo desplazamiento genera notas de crédito (no las calcula).

• Leer el desempeño de cada marca contra el plan (AOP).

• Portales de clientes, Walmart, Chedrahui, Soriana, Excel avanzado y PowerPoint ejecutivo.

. Oracle FDI como usuario de reportes;

. Inglés intermedio.

• Proactividad: da seguimiento y avisa antes de un retraso.

• Cercanía y empatía con Comercial, Finanzas y Marketing.

• Comunicación asertiva, segura ante interlocutores senior.

• Estructura y hands-on: valida sus datos antes de compartir.

4. Perfil de puesto

Formación: Administración, Finanzas, Economía, Mercadotecnia, Ing. Industrial o afín, titulado 

Experiencia: 3 a 4 años en análisis comercial, POS, planeación, finanzas comerciales o trade marketing.

Industria: juguetes, consumo masivo o retail (diferencial).

description:
Somos Dialogue Direct México, una empresa social, pioneros en la industria de recaudación de fondos cara a cara que trabaja mano a mano de las ONGs (AMNISTIA INTERNACIONAL) más importantes del mundo en protección de los derechos humanos, proporcionando compromiso activo y apoyo a largo plazo con socios individuales. Nos convertimos en la primera Corporación B Certificada de Recaudación de Fondos Cara a Cara en los Estados Unidos y estamos forjando un camino aún más fuerte ahora para redefinir el éxito en América Latina. Nuestro equipo sabe que para ser el mejor del mundo, requiere un equipo de liderazgo con determinación, pasión y resiliencia.
